A 7 bar air production station now meets the compressed air needs of several geographical areas, bringing together the establishments of Regulus, Europropulsion, ArianeGroup, Avio-G, Air Liquide Spatial Guyane, Arianespace, BEAP, ZSE, ZSP and S3 Zone.
As part of the arrival of new launch operators and the transfer of ownership of certain areas to CNES, it has become necessary to rethink the 7 bar air production/distribution network in order to guarantee a clear and equitable distribution in terms of operation, investment, consumption and maintenance, for all subscribers.
The main objective of the project is to create independent air production and distribution for the areas operated by CNES CSG, namely the ZSE, the ZSP and the S3 zone. The new installations should allow CNES to control outages for its own maintenance needs and thus limit the operational impact. CNES's responsibility for network maintenance will also be limited to the areas operated by CNES.
To achieve this, a mastery of the current network is necessary, and a map of the air network will be established in order to identify, in particular, the dead branches to be isolated or put into hibernation. The solutions chosen to meet the need will have to take into account a general upgrade of the network in the identified areas.
